chunks: Muhammad ibn Ali Majiluwayh, Ahmad ibn Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashem, and Ahmad ibn Ja'far al-Hamadani - may God be pleased with them - narrated that Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashem quoted on the authority of his father, on the authority of Ma'bad, on the authority of Al-Hussein ibn Khalid, on the authority of Al-Ridha Ali ibn Musa, on the authority of his father Musa ibn Ja'far, on the authority of his father Ja'far ibn Muhammad, on the authority of his father Muhammad ibn Ali, on the authority of his father Ali ibn Al-Hussein, on the authority of his father Al-Hussein ibn Ali, on the authority of his father Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon them all)

He said: The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said: For every nation there is a Siddiq (truth-verifier) and a Faruq (one who distinguishes truth from falsehood), and the Siddiq and Faruq of this nation is Ali ibn Abi Talib. Indeed, Ali is the ship of its salvation and the gate of its repentance. He is its Joshua, its Simon, and the Dhu al-Qarnayn. O people, indeed Ali is the Vicegerent of God and my Caliph after me among you. And he is the Commander of the Faithful and the best of the Trustees. Whoever disputes with him has indeed disputed with me, and whoever oppresses him has indeed oppressed me, and whoever overcomes him has indeed overcome me, and whoever does him good has indeed done good to me, and whoever mistreats him has indeed mistreated me, and whoever is his enemy is indeed my enemy, and whoever is his friend is indeed my friend. And this is because he is my brother and my Vizier, and he was created from my essence, and I and he were one single light.

key_terms.صِدِّيق: Truth-verifier, one who confirms the truth
key_terms.فَارُوق: One who distinguishes truth from falsehood

ai.seo_question: Who is the Siddiq and Faruq of the Muslim nation according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith, recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, presents a comprehensive theological portrait of Imam Ali as the 'Siddiq' (Truthful) and 'Faruq' (Discerner) of the Ummah, linking his authority to biblical precedents like Joshua and Simon to affirm his universal role. It explicitly declares Ali as the Prophet's *Khalifatayn* (two-fold successor) and the 'Ark of Salvation,' establishing a direct spiritual continuity where love or opposition to him is equated with love or opposition to the Prophet himself. The conclusion emphasizes the metaphysical unity of their essences, asserting that they were created from the same divine light, a core tenet of Shia cosmology regarding the *Nur Muhammad* and *Nur Ali*.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 30-30 Muhammad ibn Ali Majiluwayh, Ahmad ibn Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashem, and Ahmad ibn Ziyad ibn Ja’far al-Hamadani - may God be pleased with them - narrated that Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashem quoted on the authority of his father, on the authority of Ali ibn Ma’bad, on the authority of Al-Hussein ibn Khalid, on the authority of Al-Ridha Ali ibn Musa (s), on the authority of his father Musa ibn Ja’far (s), on the authority of his father Ja’far ibn Muhammad (s), on the authority of hisfather Muhammad ibn Ali (s), on the authority of Ali ibn Al-Hussein (s), on the authority of his father Al-Hussein ibn Ali (s), on the authority of his father Ali ibn Abi Talib (s), “God’s Prophet (s) said, There is a companion and one who distinguishes truth from falsehood for every nation. The one for this nation is Ali ibn Abi Talib. He is the ship of salvation. He is its gate of repentance. He is like its Yosha’, Sham’oon, and Thul-Qarnayn. O people! Ali is God’s vicegerent and my Caliph after me. He is the Commander of the Faithful. He is the best of the Trustees. Whoever fights with him has indeed fought with me. Whoever oppresses him has indeed oppressed me. Whoever overcomes him has indeed overcome me. Whoever does him good has indeed done good to me. Whoever mistreats him has indeed mistreated me. Whoever is his enemy is indeed my enemy. Whoever is his friend is indeed my friend, since he is my brother and Vizier. He has been created from the same essence that I have been created from. He and I are but one and the same light.’”
